name: Charlotte Adelaide Moritz
original_name: シャルロット・アデレイド・モーリッツ
source:
A new maid at Will's mansion. She is very shy and rarely speaks to strangers.

If she has any problems, she keeps them to herself. She is frail, weak-willed, and generally reserved.

She sometimes gets bullied by the other maids after being given special treatment (including personal care and sexual services) by the main character.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
